title: A PILLAGER WHO IS PICKED UP NO LONGER COUNTS AS A PLAYER 2 KILL WHEN HE DIES LATER
why: When player 2 downed a pillager and someone picked him up, the game still remembered player 2 as his killer. If the same man later died to a Howler shell, a crawler or by bleeding out, player 2 was sent a kill he did not make, with a contract tick, a grudge and the line that the man will remember it. A pick-up now clears the player 2 mark as well as the host mark, so his next death is credited to nobody unless someone causes it.
now: Kill credit, co-op hunt 2026-09-28: v15.80 added bySeat beside byPlayer, but the two places a downed pillager stands back up (your pick-up with E in updatePlayer and a crewmate pick-up in updateEnts) cleared only byPlayer. The seat mark from the player 2 downing blow survived the revive, and a later death that writes no mark (a Howler shell, a crawler bite, a bleed-out) reached netEntGone with bySeat still set, so player 2 was sent a kill word, a contract tick and a grudge for a man he did not kill. Both pick-ups now clear bySeat too, the same way netShotTake clears both marks on a blow he survives. No number and no player text moved.
